title: fragaria sylvestris var. monophylla
intro: Fragaria sylvestris var. monophylla, commonly known as the monophyllous woodland strawberry, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Fragaria sylvestris species, which is a type of strawberry plant found in woodland areas. The monophyllous woodland strawberry has been traditionally used to provide relief from various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help to protect the body from oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the monophyllous woodland strawberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
